This '''office''' was a [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] office that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] criminal [[Mebara Jos]] obtained some information that had been stolen from the office, regarding SoroSuub's [[XB-01 Speeder Bike]].
